| Source | Indication | Study population / age range | Recruitment status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **FDA Prozac pediatric labeling change** | **Major depressive disorder (MDD): 8–17 years.** **Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD): 7–17 years.** [S3](https://www.fda.gov/science-research/pediatrics/pediatric-labeling-changes) | Pediatric labeling record; a specific study-participant population is not supplied in the returned FDA metadata. | Historical labeling change dated **January 3, 2003**; recruitment status is not applicable. |
| **ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00006286 (TADS)** | **Major depressive disorder (MDD)**; the study evaluated fluoxetine, psychotherapy, and their combination. [S1](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00006286) | **Study population:** teenagers with MDD, ages **12–17**; reported planned enrollment was **432 participants**. [S1](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00006286) | **COMPLETED**—not currently recruiting. [S1](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00006286) |

**Comparison:** TADS’s participant age range (**12–17**) is narrower than the FDA Prozac MDD labeling range (**8–17**). TADS addressed **MDD**, not OCD, so its population does not provide evidence about the FDA OCD age range. The ClinicalTrials.gov narrative also states that fluoxetine had been approved for depression in ages **7–17**; that narrative statement conflicts with the FDA labeling-change record’s structured MDD range of **8–17**. The FDA record is the source used above for the requested FDA MDD age range. [S1](https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00006286) [S3](https://www.fda.gov/science-research/pediatrics/pediatric-labeling-changes)

Informational only; not medical advice. Compiled from public NIH/NLM/FDA data, which may be incomplete or out of date. Patients should talk to a clinician, pharmacist or poison control before starting, stopping or changing any medication.

expected_facts: FDA Prozac/fluoxetine change dated 2003-01-03 establishes effectiveness at ages 8-17 for MDD and 7-17 for OCD; do not substitute the combination Symbyax entry.
NCT00006286 (TADS) is COMPLETED, studying fluoxetine and psychotherapy; its summary describes 432 participants ages 12-17.

The registry narrative also says 7-17 for depression, which differs from the FDA change summary. Do not conflate that registry statement with the FDA MDD range, or treat the completed trial as recruiting.
